title: Positive lifted etale cohomology computed by a finite affine section complex
statement: Let $X$ be a separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\iota$ a finite set, $U_i$ affine open subsets with $\bigcup_i U_i=X$, and $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $F_{et}$ be the associated additive sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] and let $K=C^\bullet(U,F)$ be its module-valued section Cech complex [def-sc-module-cech-comparison], whose degree $p$ terms are the products of $\Gamma(U_{i_0}\cap\cdots\cap U_{i_p},F)$ with alternating restriction differential. Let $T$ forget $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$-module scalars and then apply the additive coefficient lift $\mathrm{ULift}:\mathrm{Ab}_u\to\mathrm{Ab}_{u+1}$. For every $n\ge0$, there exists an additive equivalence $H^{n+1}(X_{et},\mathrm{ULift}(F_{et}))\simeq H^{n+1}(T(K))$. The left group is Ext-defined Sheaf.H, while the right group is homology of the specified lifted section complex. No coefficient-universe comparison of sheaf cohomology is assumed.

source.place: Theorem 03P2, separated-case affine-cover proof; also Proposition 03DW, part (2), separated-case proof. Coefficient lifting of the finite section complex is the worker-written elaboration of that computation.

proof.text: Use zariski_to_etale_core to choose the open-subscheme inclusion, its cover preservation, finite-limit preservation and terminal top object. On all affine etale objects, obtain vanishing of positive derived evaluation by applying the finite affine etale Cech basis, lifted affine tensor Cech vanishing, and the Cech vanishing criterion.

Apply cohomology_nonempty_addEquiv_rightDerived_evaluation_succ at i(top). The acyclic finite affine open cover comparison identifies its derived evaluation with homology of the open-section Cech complex.

Apply the natural open-section presheaf isomorphism and whisker it by ULift, using functor associators. Applying cechComplexFunctor gives a complex isomorphism to the Cech complex of the lifted underlying module presheaf. The private proved liftedModuleCechIso identifies this with the lift of the module Cech complex: its components are PreservesProduct.iso, and cechComplexFunctor_d_pi, map_sum, map_zsmul and piComparison_comp_pi prove differential compatibility. Apply homologyMapIso and compose the additive equivalences.
